quote: Créase el Comité Interministerial sobre Ciberseguridad

name: Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional

quote: Son servicios esenciales aquellos provistos por los organismos de la Administración del Estado y por el Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional

quote: Formulada la oposición, la Agencia sólo podrá acceder previa autorización judicial

name: Consejo de Estabilidad Financiera
function: Coordinates with the CSIRT Nacional on incidents that may affect the normal functioning of the financial system.
quote: el Consejo de Estabilidad Financiera creado por la ley N° 20.789

name: 工业和信息化部

quote: 工业和信息化部会同有关部门负责人工智能科技伦理治

name: 科技部
function: Coordinates and guides national science-and-technology ethics supervision (Art. 29); co-issues the expert re-review list with MIIT (Art. 21); registration information is shared with it (Art. 30).
quote: 科技部负责统筹指导全国科技伦理监管工作

name: 专业性人工智能科技伦理审查与服务中心（服务中心）
function: Set up by local or related authorities on existing bodies; provides ethics review, re-review, training and consultation to other entities; may not provide review and re-review for the same activity; supervised by local or related authorities.
quote: 服务中心接受其他单位委托，提供人工智能科技活动伦理审查、复核、培训、咨询等服务

name: 省级管理部门（“地方”）
function: Provincial authority designated by the provincial government for AI ethics review and management; referred to as "地方" in the measures (Art. 33).
quote: 智能领域科技伦理审查和管理工作的省级管理部门

name: 国务院相关主管部门（“相关主管部门”）
function: Supervises AI ethics review and services within their own industries and systems (Art. 29, Art. 34); referred to as "相关主管部门" in the measures (Art. 33).
quote: “相关主管部门”是指国务院相关主管部门

name: 复核专家组
function: Expert re-review panel that local or related authorities organise to review preliminary review opinions (Art. 23).
quote: 第三十条规定组织成立复核专家组

name: 国家科技伦理管理信息登记平台
function: Registration platform through which ethics committee information and listed AI activities are registered (Art. 30).
quote: 通过国家科技伦理管理信息登记平台进行登记

name: National cybersecurity and informatization department
function: Overall coordination of nationwide algorithmic recommendation service governance and supervision (Art. 3); establishes the graded algorithm security management system (Art. 23); conducts algorithm security assessment (Art. 28)
quote: The national cybersecurity and informatization department is responsible for the overall coordination of nationwide algorithmic recommendation service governance and related supervision and management work

name: Local cybersecurity and informatization departments

quote: Local cybersecurity and informatization departments are responsible for the overall coordination of nationwide algorithmic recommendation service governance

name: State Council telecommunications, public security, market regulation and other relevant departments

quote: responsible for algorithmic recommendation service supervision and management work.

name: National, provincial, autonomous region and municipal cybersecurity and informatization departments

name: State Administration of Market Regulation
function: Jointly responsible for interpreting these Provisions (Art. 34)

name: Local cybersecurity and informatization departments

quote: the relevant departments of the State Council, such as for development and reform, industry and informatization, public security, market regulation, and press and publication

function: Carries out anti-online-violence work and supervision within its remit and combats online violence crimes.

name: 地方网信部门
function: Coordinates anti-online-violence work and supervision within its administrative area.

name: 地方公安部门
function: Carries out anti-online-violence work and supervision within its administrative area and combats online violence crimes.

function: Receives reports of online violence, investigates and files cases, may issue online violence warning letters (告诫书) for conduct not subject to public security administrative penalties, and assists courts in private prosecutions.
quote: 公安机关可以对实施网络暴力活动的组织或者个人出具网络暴力告诫书

name: 教育部门
function: Guides schools in anti-online-violence education and integration into curricula.
quote: 教育部门应当指导学校加强反网络暴力宣传教育

function: Handles online violence cases; hears applications for personality-right infringement injunctions (Art. 37) and private prosecutions (Art. 41).

function: Organisation determined by the national cyberspace authority that may bring public-interest suits under Art. 43.
quote: 人民检察院或者国家网信部门确定的组织可以依法向人民法院提起公益诉讼

quote: 各区发展改革委、北京经济技术开发区经济发展局和行政审批局 [district DRCs, and the Economic Development Bureau and Administrative Approval Bureau of the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area]

quote: 北京经济技术开发区经济发展局和行政审批局

name: Digital health authorities (each Member State)
function: Responsible for implementing and enforcing Chapter II at national level; adopt technical solutions; supervise national contact points; cooperate with supervisory and other authorities; perform market surveillance where applicable (Art. 19(1)-(2)).
quote: Each Member State shall designate one or more digital health authorities responsible for the implementation and enforcement of this Chapter at national level.

name: National contact points for digital health (each Member State)
function: Organisational and technical gateway for cross-border exchange of personal electronic health data in primary use, connected to MyHealth@EU (Art. 23(2)-(3)).
quote: Each Member State shall designate one national contact point for digital health, as an organisational and technical gateway

name: European Commission
function: Establishes and operates the MyHealth@EU central interoperability platform; acts as processor for the joint controllers; carries out compliance checks; adopts implementing acts (Art. 23(1), (4), (7)-(9)).
quote: The Commission shall establish a central interoperability platform for digital health

name: Supervisory authorities under Regulation (EU) 2016/679
function: Competent for monitoring and enforcing Articles 3 and 5 to 10 of this Regulation; empowered to impose administrative fines (Art. 22).
quote: The supervisory authority or supervisory authorities responsible for monitoring and enforcing the application of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 shall also be competent for monitoring and enforcing the application of Articles 3 and 5 to 10 of this Regulation.

name: European Commission
function: Adopts implementing and delegated acts under this Part; develops, deploys and operates the central platform for HealthData@EU; performs tasks for Union institutions as health data holders.
quote: The Commission shall develop, deploy and operate a central platform for HealthData@EU

name: Health data access bodies
function: Designated by Member States to carry out the tasks and obligations in Articles 57, 58 and 59 (access applications, data permits, supervision and public information).
quote: Member States shall designate one or more health data access bodies responsible for carrying out the tasks and obligations set out in Articles 57, 58 and 59.

name: Union health data access service
function: Performs the Art. 57 and Art. 59 tasks where the health data holders are Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies; acts as contact point for secondary use for the Union institutions (Art. 75(2)).

name: Market surveillance authorities
function: Designated by Member States for implementing Chapter III; empowered to take measures under Article 16 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 and to prohibit or restrict EHR systems.
quote: Member States shall designate the market surveillance authority or authorities responsible for the implementation of this Chapter.

name: National contact point for secondary use
function: Organisational and technical gateway for making electronic health data available for secondary use in a cross-border context via HealthData@EU.
quote: Each Member State shall designate one national contact point for secondary use.

name: Digital health authorities
function: Designated under Article 19 (not in this part); may be the same authorities as the market surveillance authorities.
quote: the digital health authorities designated pursuant to Article 19

name: European Health Data Space Board (EHDS Board)
function: Established to facilitate cooperation and exchange of information among Member States and the Commission; adopts decisions and coordinates implementation.
quote: A European Health Data Space Board (the ‘EHDS Board’) is hereby established

name: Stakeholder forum
function: Established to facilitate exchange of information and cooperation among stakeholders; members appointed by the Commission.
quote: A stakeholder forum is hereby established

name: MyHealth@EU and HealthData@EU steering groups
function: Established for the cross-border infrastructures; take operational decisions on development and operation of MyHealth@EU and HealthData@EU.
quote: The MyHealth@EU steering group and the HealthData@EU steering group (the ‘steering groups’) are hereby established

name: Supervisory authorities under Regulation (EU) 2016/679
function: Competent for monitoring and enforcing the opt-out right under Article 71; empowered to impose administrative fines under Article 83 of that Regulation.
quote: The supervisory authority or authorities responsible for monitoring and enforcing the application of Regulation (EU) 2016/679

name: Contracting authorities (including digital health authorities and health data access bodies)
function: Must refer to applicable technical specifications, standards and profiles in public procurement and tender documents and calls for proposals.
quote: Contracting authorities, including digital health authorities and health data access bodies

name: Medical Device Coordination Group (MDCG)
function: Consultation body that may be consulted before adoption of common specifications affecting medical devices.
quote: the Medical Device Coordination Group (MDCG) established by Article 103 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745

name: European Artificial Intelligence Board
function: Consultation body that may be consulted before adoption of common specifications affecting high-risk AI systems.
quote: the European Artificial Intelligence Board established by Article 65 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

name: European Data Protection Board (EDPB)
function: Invited to attend EHDS Board meetings where relevant; consulted on common specifications.
quote: the EDPB and the European Data Protection Supervisor

name: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA)
function: Invited to attend EHDS Board meetings where relevant.
quote: the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA)

name: European Board for Media Services (the Board)
function: Established as an independent advisory body at Union level, replacing ERGA; tasks in Article 13 and opinions under Articles 14, 15, 17, 21, 22 and 23.
quote: The European Board for Media Services (the ‘Board’) is hereby established.

name: National regulatory authorities or bodies
function: Designated by Member States under Article 30 of Directive 2010/13/EU; ensure application of Chapter III, cooperate with each other, sit on the Board, and report on state advertising allocation (Article 25(3)).
quote: ‘national regulatory authority or body’ means any authority or body designated by a Member State pursuant to Article 30 of Directive 2010/13/EU

name: European Commission
function: Provides the Board secretariat (Article 11); issues guidelines (e.g. Articles 16(2), 18(9), 22(3), 24(4)); ensures the monitoring exercise (Article 26); evaluates the Regulation (Article 27).

name: Independent authority or body providing assistance under Article 4(8)

quote: Member States shall entrust an independent authority or body with relevant expertise to provide assistance to the persons referred to in the first subparagraph

name: Independent authorities or bodies monitoring public service media safeguards

name: Authorities responsible for national media ownership databases

name: Contact committee established by Article 29(1) of Directive 2010/13/EU

name: European Regulators Group for Audiovisual Media Services (ERGA)

name: European Commission

quote: The Commission shall establish a European database on data centres

name: Entity or entities identified by each Member State for monitoring the energy efficiency first principle

name: Competent authority or body designated by each Member State for energy audits

name: European Commission

name: National energy regulatory authorities

name: Single points of contact (consumer information)

name: Dedicated one-stop shops for energy efficiency advice

name: Energy ombudsperson (optional)

quote: designate an ombudsperson to ensure the efficient handling of complaints

name: Gas and electricity transmission and distribution system operators

name: Data centres with a total rated energy input exceeding 1 MW

quote: This Directive is addressed to the Member States.

name: European Commission ('the Commission')
function: Receives notifications from Member States (Art. 3(3), Art. 14(2), Art. 17(2)) and must submit a report on the application of the Directive (Art. 18).
quote: The Commission shall submit to the European Parliament and the Council

function: Carries out the tasks laid down in Article 30 of Directive 95/46/EC with regard to matters covered by this Directive (Art. 15(3)).
quote: shall also carry out the tasks laid down in Article 30 of that Directive

name: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking

name: European Commission

quote: Each Member State shall provide for one or more independent public authorities to be responsible for monitoring the application of this Regulation

name: Lead supervisory authority

name: European Commission

name: CSIRT designated as coordinator for coordinated vulnerability disclosure (national)
function: Acts as trusted intermediary between reporting persons and manufacturers or providers of vulnerable ICT products or services (Art 12(1)).

name: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA)
function: Develops and maintains the European vulnerability database (Art 12(2)); provides the secretariat of the CSIRTs network (Art 15(2)) and of EU-CyCLONe (Art 16(2)); assists Member States on strategies and CSIRT development (Art 7(4), Art 10(10)).

name: European Commission

name: Cooperation Group
function: Body established to support strategic cooperation and exchange of information among Member States; works on biennial work programmes (Art 14(1)-(2)).
quote: a Cooperation Group is established.

name: CSIRTs network

name: European cyber crisis liaison organisation network (EU-CyCLONe)
function: Supports coordinated management of large-scale cybersecurity incidents and crises at operational level (Art 16(1)); tasks in Art 16(3).

name: CERT-EU (computer emergency response team for the Union's institutions, bodies and agencies)

name: European External Action Service

name: Critical Entities Resilience Group

name: Cooperation Group

name: Oversight Forum (established under Article 32(1) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554)
function: Informed by competent authorities when exercising supervisory and enforcement powers over essential or important entities designated as critical ICT third-party service providers (Arts. 31(10) and 33(6)).

function: Addressees of the technical and methodological requirements in the Annex (Art. 2(1)) and of the significant-incident criteria in Arts. 5 to 14. The categories are defined by reference to Art. 3 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (recital 1).
quote: with regard to DNS service providers, TLD name registries, cloud computing service providers, data centre service providers

name: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA)

quote: National competent authorities may, when exercising supervision, take into account the appropriate time required

function: Receive incident notifications from relevant entities (Annex, point 3.5.3(a)); provide information on incidents, vulnerabilities, threats and mitigation measures that entities must process (Annex, point 4.3.3).

name: European Commission

quote: The Commission shall draw up a list of the organisations, associations and public bodies designated in accordance with paragraph 5.

name: Member States

name: Member States

name: Member States
function: Addressees of the Directive; must bring into force transposing measures by 9 December 2026 and communicate main national measures to the Commission (Art. 22); must notify any measures maintained or introduced under the development risk derogation (Art. 18).
quote: This Directive is addressed to the Member States.

name: European Commission
function: Sets up and maintains the publicly available database of judgments (Art. 19(2)); receives notifications and may issue non-binding opinions on proposed national development risk measures (Art. 18(4)-(5)); carries out the evaluation and reports (Art. 20).
quote: The Commission shall set up and maintain an easily accessible and publicly available database

name: Turvallisuus- ja kemikaalivirasto
function: Market surveillance authority for high-risk AI systems in the sectors listed in 3 § para 1 point 1 and 3 § para 2 point 2 (gas and water); its accreditation service issues accreditation certificates to conformity assessment bodies (9 §).
quote: Turvallisuus- ja kemikaalivirasto tekoälyasetuksen liitteen I jakson A

name: Tulli (Customs)
function: Market surveillance authority for AI Act Annex I section A point 2 products, under the customs carve-out in 3 § para 1 point 2.
quote: Tulli tekoälyasetuksen liitteen I jakson A kohdassa 2 mainitun säädöksen osalta

name: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto
function: Market surveillance for Annex I points 3 and 6 and for road transport and critical digital infrastructure (3 §); supervision of AI Act Art. 50 transparency duties (5 §); single point of contact under Art. 70(2) (6 §); notifying authority for conformity bodies in Annex I points 3 and 6 (8 § point 2); hosts the sanctions board (13 §).
quote: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto toimii tekoälyasetuksen 70 artiklan 2 kohdassa tarkoitettuna keskitettynä yhteyspisteenä.

name: Lupa- ja valvontavirasto
function: Market surveillance for Annex III point 5 (a) and (d) use cases (3 § para 2 point 5); work-protection authority for Annex I point 8 and for products under 3 § para 1 point 4; member appointed to the sanctions board (13 §).
quote: Lupa- ja valvontavirasto työsuojeluviranomaisena tekoälyasetuksen liitteen I jakson

name: Tietosuojavaltuutettu (Data Protection Ombudsman)
function: Market surveillance authority for prohibited AI practices under AI Act Art. 5 (4 §); market surveillance for listed Annex III use cases (3 § para 2 point 4); notified body for high-risk AI used by law enforcement, migration or asylum authorities (11 §).
quote: Tietosuojavaltuutettu valvoo markkinavalvontaviranomaisena tekoälyasetuksen 5 artiklan

name: Finanssivalvonta
function: Market surveillance for listed Annex III point 5 use cases in financial and insurance sectors (3 § para 2 point 6); authority reporting to the European Central Bank under AI Act Art. 74(7) (7 §).
quote: Finanssivalvonta on tekoälyasetuksen 74 artiklan 7 kohdan toisessa alakohdassa tarkoitettu

name: Energiavirasto
function: Market surveillance for critical infrastructure in Annex III point 2 where the AI system is a safety component in heating, electricity or gas network management (3 § para 2 point 1).
quote: Energiavirasto mainitun liitteen 2 kohdassa tarkoitetun kriittisen infrastruktuurin

name: Lääkealan turvallisuus- ja kehittämiskeskus
function: Market surveillance for AI Act Annex I section A points 11 and 12 (3 § para 1 point 5); notifying authority for conformity bodies in those areas (8 § point 3).
quote: Lääkealan turvallisuus- ja kehittämiskeskus tekoälyasetuksen liitteen I jakson A

name: Työ- ja elinkeinoministeriö
function: Notifying authority for conformity bodies seeking designation for Annex I section A points 2, 4, 5, 7 and 10 products and Annex III point 1 systems (8 § point 1); designates notified bodies (9 §).
quote: työ- ja elinkeinoministeriö, jos vaatimustenmukaisuuden arviointilaitos hakee ilmoitetuksi laitokseksi

name: Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö
function: Notifying authority for conformity bodies seeking designation for Annex I section A points 1, 8 and 9 products (8 § point 4).
quote: sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö, jos vaatimustenmukaisuuden arviointilaitos hakee ilmoitetuksi laitokseksi

name: Tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnan seuraamusmaksulautakunta (seuraamusmaksulautakunta)
function: Imposes administrative sanction fees (seuraamusmaksu) under 14 to 22 §, on a proposal by the competent market surveillance authority; sits within Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto; members nominated by Traficom, the Data Protection Ombudsman, Lupa- ja valvontavirasto and other market surveillance authorities (13 §).
quote: Liikenne- ja viestintäviraston yhteydessä toimii tekoälyjärjestelmien valvonnan seuraamusmaksulautakunta

name: Verohallinto
function: Administers excise taxation, including electricity tax; text also refers to support notifications to it.
quote: Valmisteverotuksen toimittamisesta vastaa Verohallinto.

name: Valtiovarainministeriö
function: Ministry that prepared the bill.
quote: Esitys on valmisteltu valtiovarainministeriössä.

name: Société […] (redacted in the text; referred to as 'la société')
function: Controller of the facial recognition database and search service; subject to the administrative fine, injunction and penalty payment, and to publication of the decision
quote: La société […] (ci-après la société ou […]), établie aux États-Unis

name: Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés (CNIL), formation restreinte
function: Supervisory authority; its restricted panel imposes the administrative fine, injunction, penalty payment and publication under loi 78-17 article 20 (III), as cited in the text
quote: La Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés (ci-après la CNIL ) a été saisie entre mai et décembre 2020

name: Privacy International
function: Organisation whose complaint (saisine n° […]) was received by the CNIL on 27 May 2021
quote: la CNIL a été saisie d’une plainte de l’organisme Privacy International

name: Agence de l'environnement et de la maîtrise de l'énergie

name: Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques, des postes et de la distribution de la presse

name: Conseil supérieur de l'audiovisuel
function: Publishes a recommendation on consumer information about energy consumption and greenhouse gas equivalents of data use by television, on-demand audiovisual media and video-sharing platform services (Art. 26, L. 38-6); with the Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques, des postes et de la distribution de la presse, defines the ecodesign referential (Art. 25).
quote: Le Conseil supérieur de l'audiovisuel, en lien avec l'Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques, des postes et de la distribution de la presse et l'Agence de l'environnement et de la maîtrise de l'énergie, publie une recommandation

name: Communes de plus de 50 000 habitants
function: Must define a responsible digital strategy with reduction objectives by 1 January 2025 and prepare a preparatory work programme by 1 January 2023 (Art. 35 I). The same duties apply to EPCI with own tax revenue grouping more than 50,000 inhabitants (Art. 35 I, last paragraph).

name: Commission définie à l'article L. 311-5 du code de la propriété intellectuelle

name: Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique (ARCOM)
function: Elaborates the referential to which gambling-communication exclusion mechanisms must conform (Art. 4 VII).

name: Autorité nationale des jeux
function: Consulted when the ARCOM referential on gambling-communication exclusion mechanisms is elaborated (Art. 4 VII).
quote: après consultation de l'Autorité nationale des jeux et de la Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés

name: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL)
function: Consulted when the ARCOM referential on gambling-communication exclusion mechanisms is elaborated (Art. 4 VII).
quote: après consultation de l'Autorité nationale des jeux et de la Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés

name: Autorité administrative chargée de la concurrence et de la consommation

quote: de la direction générale de la concurrence, de la consommation et de la répression des fraudes

name: Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF)
function: Named in the evaluation-report obligation (Art. 17 2°).
quote: de l'Autorité des marchés financiers, de l'Autorité nationale des jeux

name: Coordinateur pour les services numériques compétent
function: Grants trusted-flagger status to entities meeting the DSA art. 22 conditions and acting against violations of this law and other listed codes (Art. 11, LCEN art. 6-4-2, second paragraph).
quote: Le coordinateur pour les services numériques compétent attribue le statut de signaleur de confiance

name: Commission européenne
function: Its response to the notification of the legislation determines whether Arts 10 to 12 and 15 may enter into force (Art. 18, first paragraph).
quote: la réponse de la Commission européenne

name: Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique
function: Issues the referential for age-verification and parental-consent technical solutions (art. 6-7 I); its president sends formal notices and may refer providers to the Paris court (art. 6-7 II).
quote: le président de l'Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique adresse à ce fournisseur

name: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
function: Consulted on the Arcom referential (art. 6-7 I) and on the implementing decree (art. 6-7 IV).

name: Tribunal judiciaire de Paris (président)

name: Commission européenne

quote: la réponse de la Commission européenne permettant de considérer le dispositif législatif lui ayant été notifié comme conforme au droit de l'Union européenne

name: Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique

quote: L'Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique est désignée coordinateur pour les services numériques

name: Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques, des postes et de la distribution de la presse
function: Competent authority for data intermediation services (arts 36 to 38); cloud service inquiries, disputes and sanctions (arts 27 to 30); proposes a data-transfer price ceiling by order and issues guidelines on switching costs (Art. 27 V, VI); interoperability specifications (Art. 29).
quote: L'Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques, des postes et de la distribution de la presse est l'autorité compétente en matière de services d'intermédiation de données

name: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
function: Designated competent authority under the DSA (LCEN art. 7); names the qualified person supervising blocking measures (Art. 24 III); consulted on age-verification and blocking decrees (Art. 1, Art. 24 VI) and on data intermediation matters (Art. 38).
quote: 3° La Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés

name: Autorité de la concurrence
function: May take up complaints on self-preferencing by cloud providers and sanction them under the competition code (CdC art. L. 442-12 V); may receive referrals of dominant-position abuses in cloud markets from ARCEP (Art. 30 IV).
quote: L'Autorité de la concurrence peut, soit d'office, soit à la demande du ministre chargé du numérique

name: Autorité nationale des jeux
function: Receives prior declarations of games with digital monetisable objects (Art. 41 I A); controls compliance and issues orders (Art. 41 X, XVII, XX); sanctions via its collège and sanctions commission (Art. 41 XXIII to XXV); coordinates with the authority in art. 39-1 of Loi 2010-476.
quote: la déclare préalablement à l'Autorité nationale des jeux

name: Cour de cassation
function: Supervises personal-data processing by judicial courts and their prosecution offices and by the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature in disciplinary matters (CJ art. L. 453-1); hears appeals against decisions of its supervisory authority (art. L. 453-2).
provision: Art. 46 I (inserting Code de l'organisation judiciaire, Art. L. 453-1 I)
quote: La Cour de cassation est chargée du contrôle des opérations de traitement des données à caractère personnel

name: Conseil d'Etat
function: Supervises personal-data processing by administrative courts and the Tribunal des conflits in their judicial function (CJA art. L. 115-1).
provision: Art. 45 (inserting Code de justice administrative, Art. L. 115-1 I)
quote: Le Conseil d'Etat est chargé du contrôle des opérations de traitement des données à caractère personnel

name: Cour des comptes
function: Supervises personal-data processing by courts under the financial jurisdictions code (CJF art. L. 111-18).

name: Service administratif de l'Etat mentionné à l'article 36 de la loi n° 2021-1382

quote: recourir à l'assistance technique du service administratif de l'Etat mentionné à l'article 36 de la loi n° 2021-1382

name: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information
function: Member of the national network for coordinating digital services regulation (LCEN art. 7-4); named as the certifying body in a government report on a possible encryption audit for non-EU cloud providers (Art. 31 VI).
quote: 5° L'Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information

name: Autorité des relations sociales des plateformes d'emploi
function: Member of the national network for coordinating digital services regulation (LCEN art. 7-4).
quote: 6° L'Autorité des relations sociales des plateformes d'emploi

name: Office central de lutte contre la criminalité liée aux technologies de l'information et de la communication
function: Subject of a government report, due within six months of promulgation, on extending its powers to remove certain content (Art. 6).
quote: l'Office central de lutte contre la criminalité liée aux technologies de l'information et de la communication

name: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
function: Competent authority under Art. 49 of Regulation 2022/2065 (art. 124-5); competent authority under Art. 26 of Regulation 2022/868 and keeper of the register of data altruism organisations (art. 124-1, 124-2); complaint handling (art. 124-3); powers under art. 20 (commitments, formal notices, sanctions).
quote: La Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés est une autorité administrative indépendante

name: Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique
function: Monitors compliance by video-sharing platform services with section 4 of the LCEN (art. 60 IV of Law 86-1067); publishes a periodic review of measures taken by very large platforms and search engines (art. 58 last paragraph of Law 86-1067).

name: Autorité de la concurrence
function: National authority for enforcing listed provisions of Regulation 2022/1925 (L. 450-11); also designated for Art. 27 of that regulation (L. 462-9-2); competition powers under L. 450-12.

name: Coordinateur des services numériques (LCEN, art. 7-2)

name: Premier ministre

name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
function: Established as a body corporate; oversees and enforces the Act, keeps the register of data controllers and processors, investigates complaints, conducts inspections and audits, and issues penalty notices; headed by the Data Commissioner.
quote: There is established the office of the Data Protection Commissioner which shall be a body corporate

name: Public Service Commission
function: Initiates recruitment and receives applications for the Data Commissioner post, nominates candidates, and receives removal complaints against the Data Commissioner.
quote: The Public Service Commission shall, whenever a vacancy arises in the position of the Data Commissioner, initiate the recruitment process.

name: Cabinet Secretary
function: Responsible for matters relating to information, communication and technology; empowered to make regulations for giving effect to the Act, prescribe processing through servers or data centres in Kenya, and issue further automated-decision safeguards.
quote: The Cabinet Secretary may, make regulations generally for giving effect to this Act

name: 개인정보 보호위원회 (Personal Information Protection Commission)
function: Independent commission under the Prime Minister; exercises supervisory and enforcement powers under this Act (investigations, corrective orders, administrative fines, surcharges, publication orders).
quote: 국무총리 소속으로 개인정보 보호위원회(이하 “보호위원회”라 한다)를 둔다.

name: 개인정보 분쟁조정위원회 (Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee)
function: Mediates personal-information disputes, including collective dispute mediation and recommendations to other bodies (Arts. 40-50, 50-2).
quote: 개인정보 분쟁조정위원회(이하 “분쟁조정위원회”라 한다)를 둔다.

name: 개인정보관리 전문기관 (designated personal-information management bodies)
function: Designated by the Commission or a central administrative agency head to support data-subject transmission requests (Art. 35-3); also subject to Commission supervision.
quote: 보호위원회 또는 관계 중앙행정기관의 장으로부터 개인정보관리 전문기관의 지정을 받아야 한다.

name: 평가기관 (impact-assessment bodies)
function: Bodies designated by the Commission to conduct impact assessments that public agencies must commission (Art. 33(2)).
quote: 영향평가를 수행하는 기관(이하 “평가기관”이라 한다)으로 지정할 수 있으며

name: 가명정보 결합 전문기관 (designated pseudonymised-data combination institutions)
function: Designated by the Commission or a central administrative agency head to combine pseudonymised data across controllers and approve export of combined data (Art. 28-3).
quote: 보호위원회 또는 관계 중앙행정기관의 장이 지정하는 전문기관이 수행한다.

name: 침해 신고 전문기관 (designated reporting bodies, incl. 신고센터)
function: Designated by the Commission to receive and process reports of infringement and to operate a reporting centre (Art. 62).
quote: 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 전문기관을 지정할 수 있다

name: 관계 중앙행정기관의 장 (heads of relevant central administrative agencies)
function: May recommend improvements to controllers under their own laws (Art. 61(3)); may designate personal-information management bodies with the Commission (Art. 35-3(1)).
quote: 관계 중앙행정기관의 장은 개인정보 보호를 위하여 필요하다고 인정하면 소관 법률에 따라 개인정보처리자에게 개인정보 처리 실태의 개선을 권고할 수 있다.

name: 과학기술정보통신부장관 (Minister of Science and ICT)
function: Competent authority under the Act for registration, notification, licensing, reporting and most administrative powers; may conduct fact surveys of app market operators (Art. 22-9(2)), order service suspensions (Art. 32-3) and impose surcharges (Art. 53).
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관 또는 방송미디어통신위원회는 모바일콘텐츠 등의 거래를 중개하는 공간

name: 방송미디어통신위원회 (Korea Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission)
function: Enforcement authority for app market and anti-competitive provisions: investigations and inspections (Art. 51), corrective orders and suspension of conduct (Art. 52), surcharges (Art. 53), emergency orders (Art. 32-18), and fact surveys of app market operators (Art. 22-9(2)).
quote: 방송미디어통신위원회는 신고나 인지에 의하여

name: 공익성심사위원회 (Public Interest Review Committee)
function: Established within the Ministry to review whether ownership changes and foreign-investment agreements harm public interests under Art. 10.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부에 공익성심사위원회(이하 “위원회”라 한다)를 둔다.

name: 통신분쟁조정위원회 (Telecommunications Dispute Mediation Committee)
function: May be set up by the Commission to mediate disputes between telecom businesses and users, including app market payment and refund disputes (Art. 45-2(1)(6)).
quote: 통신분쟁조정위원회(이하 “분쟁조정위원회”라 한다)를 둘 수 있다

name: 한국정보통신진흥협회 (Korea Information and Communications Promotion Association)
function: Entrusted with operation of the illegal-subscription prevention system (Art. 32-5(3)); designated as dedicated support body for name-misuse prevention services (Art. 32-6(3)); entrusted with checking used-device export (Art. 32-17(3)) and with Art. 60-2 device-blocking tasks as provided by decree.
quote: 한국정보통신진흥협회(이하 “한국정보통신진흥협회”라 한다)에 위탁할 수 있다.

name: 한국인터넷진흥원 (Korea Internet & Security Agency)
function: Entrusted by the Minister with checking compliance with the forged-number measures and handling related reports (Art. 84-2(5)); the entrustment is made under the Network Act's Art. 52.
quote: 한국인터넷진흥원에 업무를 위탁하고 이에 소요되는 비용을 지원할 수 있다.

name: 문화체육관광부장관 (Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism)
function: Receives the Minister of Science and ICT's notice of online video service filings and changes (Art. 22(7)); a co-requesting authority for Art. 27(1)(6) orders.
quote: 문화체육관광부장관과 방송미디어통신위원회에 통보하여야 한다.

name: 공정거래위원회 (Korea Fair Trade Commission)
function: May be asked by the Commission to conduct investigations and take measures against handset manufacturers that discriminate in supply (Art. 32-13(6)).
quote: 공정거래위원회에 필요한 조사 및 조치를 할 것을 요청할 수 있다

name: 행정안전부장관 (Minister of the Interior and Safety)
function: Provides resident registration data on request to the name-misuse prevention service agency (Art. 32-6(4)).
quote: 행정안전부장관에게 「주민등록법」 제30조제1항에 따른 주민등록전산정보자료의 제공을 요청할 수 있다

name: 한국저작권위원회 (Korea Copyright Commission)
function: Deliberation required before the Minister may request a Art. 27(1)(6) order based on repeated copyright fines.

quote: Las Instituciones deberán requerir a las personas físicas que de manera presencial soliciten la celebración

function: Reference registry for passports and consular identification cards verified online; also the authority for verification of customers who cannot provide biometric data.

quote: coincida, al menos, en un noventa por ciento con los registros de la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores

function: Registry against which the customer's Clave Única de Registro de Población is corroborated.
quote: corroborar la existencia de la Clave Única de Registro de Población del cliente con el Registro Nacional de Población

name: Comisión Nacional de Hidrocarburos
function: Named in Transitorio Quinto (acts issued before secondary legislation remain effective) and in Transitorio Sexto (commissioners conclude functions); no express extinction statement for this body.

quote: El incumplimiento a lo dispuesto en los presentes Lineamientos será sancionado por la Comisión
